title: PipeShare BASE login default (pipeshare.live)
description:
On https://pipeshare.live, sign-in now defaults to the PipeShare client portal instead of PipeSync. Explicit ?product=pipesync deep links still open PipeSync. SaaS tenant hosts are unchanged.

Who is affected: anyone signing in at pipeshare.live / www.pipeshare.live without a product query param.
changeLog: resolveLoginProduct: default product=pipeshare on pipeshare.live / www.pipeshare.live
login.js host check aligned with React login bundle
